data.narrative:
Fourth Power operates in the Climate & Energy sector at Series A stage, with founders Asegun Henry and Arvin Ganesan having raised $40M+ to date. The broader sector includes 9 peers tracked across public and private markets, anchored by 1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. Stage-Progression methodology applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for advancement from Series A to subsequent rounds, using the $40M total raised as a valuation proxy. This produces an implied value of $80M. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable; while 9 same-sector peers exist, none yielded three or more datapoints across same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters necessary for reliable median calculation. Drawing from the full sector without these controls would introduce material bias.

The triangulated valuation range is $68M (low) to $92M (high), with a median of $80M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method rather than consensus across multiple triangulation approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of directly comparable Series A Climate & Energy transactions and the degree to which pre-Series A capital deployment ($40M) represents fair proxy for post-money valuation. Investors should treat this range as directional; a more robust estimate would require either expanded peer dataset or additional transaction comps in the frontier-energy subsector.
